platform.description: Stop stitching together forms, spreadsheets and payment tools. Donorfit connects every part of your fundraising.

features.title: Online donations
features.description: Branded donation forms and campaign pages that work beautifully on every device.

features.title: Recurring giving
features.description: Monthly and annual giving with SEPA mandates, automatic retries and donor self-service.

features.title: Campaigns & appeals
features.description: Goal-based appeals with live progress, milestones, QR codes and matched giving.

features.title: Donor management
features.description: One profile per supporter with full giving history, consent records and notes.

features.title: Sponsorship
features.description: Manage sponsors, beneficiaries and progress updates with role-based safeguarding.

features.title: Reporting & insights
features.description: Retention, campaign and fund reports ready for your board, trustees and auditors.

forms.title: Donation forms that donors actually finish
forms.description: A clear two-step checkout with your branding, the payment methods your supporters prefer and receipts sent automatically.

features.title: Your brand
features.text: Match your colours, fonts and imagery.

features.title: Embed anywhere
features.text: WordPress, Webflow, Squarespace or custom sites.

features.title: Donors cover fees
features.text: Optional fee cover so you receive the full gift.

recurring.title: Predictable income, without chasing payments
recurring.description: Turn one-off supporters into monthly donors and let Donorfit handle the collections, retries and changes.
